fixtures.name: brief-v1
fixtures.expectedText:
NORTHSTAR STUDIO | CREATIVE BRIEF | V1

SYNTHETIC TEST MATERIAL. All names, dates, decisions and commercial details are fictional.

Client: Oat & Ember. Campaign: A Better Morning.

Objective: Introduce an oat drink for everyday coffee rituals.

Audience: Adult home-coffee drinkers in the US and UK.

Key message: Small rituals, brighter mornings. Café & kitchen moments.

Mandatory: Show the carton label clearly.
Do not make nutrition or environmental claims.

Delivery request: One 30-second hero in 16:9 and one 15-second social cutdown in 9:16.

Bid basis: One studio day, one location, two adult performers; no travel.

Agency supplies: Approved logo, pack artwork and legal copy before the shoot.

Schedule assumption: First cut 2030-04-08; feedback within two working days.

Open issue: Reconcile duration and locations against the production memo. No automatic scope adoption.

fixtures.expectedText:
NORTHSTAR STUDIO | PRODUCTION MEMO | V1

SYNTHETIC TEST MATERIAL. This is a conflicting estimate input, not an approval.

Hero request: 45 seconds in 16:9. This conflicts with the 30-second deliverables matrix.

Location request: Two locations and one travel day. This conflicts with the one-location creative brief.

Estimate assumption: Two rounds of editorial revisions; a new concept is additional scope.

Exclusions: Travel, overtime, talent renewals and third-party music licenses remain unpriced.

Language request: en-US only; captions supplied as separate reviewed text.

Producer action: Resolve the duration and locations in writing before confirming production scope.
